messages:
alex: heads up, i found a CI artifact that contains an echoed env var named EXPORT_API_KEY. saw it while doing a preflight grep of artifacts. not great :grimacing:

riley: can you drop a redacted snippet?

alex: sanitized example below:
```
[2026-03-10T09:14:22Z] export EXPORT_API_KEY=\"sk-prod-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx\"
[2026-03-10T09:14:22Z] ./scripts/run-integration.sh --token=$EXPORT_API_KEY
```

jordan: that looks like the integrations-batch service key. if that hit artifacts we should rotate and tighten CI logging immediately.

priya: quick action plan:
- rotate the leaked service key and write new secret to Vault (KMS-wrapped)
- revoke old key and update callers
- remove any `echo` or `set -x` that exposes envs in CI scripts
- add CI-side masking/redaction and an artifact scanner for token-like patterns

alex: opening PR to remove the echo and add a test that fails if token-like strings are printed. will also flip a feature flag to enable runner log redaction in staging.

infra-ci-bot: feature available: `ci.log.redact` on runners v2.2. docs: https://docs.internal/ci/redaction

security-bot: audit: ci-leak-detection fired for repo redwood-integrations. exposure window: 2026-03-05..2026-03-10. recommended: rotate secrets, revoke old tokens, enable CI masking, run artifact scan across last 30 days.

riley: tagging @security-approvals for KMS unwrap/signing perms. policy requires two approvers for production KMS unwrap.

security-approvals: please attach the ticket and list principals that will have decrypt permissions. production rotations require scheduled maintenance.

alex: created ticket INF-7421 with details. plan: generate new secret in Vault, wrap with KMS key `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/integration-wrap`. will use a short-lived staging token first.

priya: infra/ci: can we add a lightweight runner hook to redact env var patterns so scripts don't need to change? prefer opt-in via pipeline flag.

infra-ci-bot: implemented `ci.log.redact` flag. will roll out to staging tonight and add a test harness.

jordan: rotate now but keep old key marked deprecated for 24h to avoid breakages; follow with full rotate once smoke tests pass.

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/integrations/pull/657 — removes env echos, adds unit test, and toggles `ci.log.redact` for staging. cc @riley @priya

security-bot: artifact-scan results: 4 artifacts with token-like strings found; 2 in staging logs, 2 partially masked in archived prod logs. recommended: rotate immediately and review bucket ACLs.

priya: decided: set CI_LOG_LEVEL=info in prod runners until masking is confirmed. i'll update infra config now.

ci-bot: deploy: runners v2.2 with `ci.log.redact` enabled on staging — deployment OK.

alex: rotation completed for integrations-batch key. new secret stored in Vault and KMS-wrapped; old token revoked. smoke tests passed.

jordan: created follow-up INF-7430 to add automated artifact scanning post-build and a daily leak-detection alert.

riley: can security compile an audit of principals with KMS decrypt perms and schedule rotation for long-lived credentials?

lead-security: will compile list and begin rotation cadence. we will notify impacted teams and require HSM audit logging for unwrap events.

alex: closing loop: PR merged, pipeline updated, rotation done. will monitor artifact alerts for 72h. please flag other leaky scripts.

ci-bot: PSA: avoid `set -x` and printing exported secrets in scripts. added to CI best-practices doc.
